rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: On the CEC protocol of 7 March 2012 (71,701,665 voters took part), the CEC declares the presidential election valid and deems Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin elected President of the Russian Federation with 45,602,075 votes (63.60 per cent). Annex: Zhirinovsky 4,458,103 (6.22%), Zyuganov 12,318,353 (17.18%), Mironov 2,763,935 (3.85%), Prokhorov 5,722,508 (7.98%), Putin 45,602,075 (63.60%). Signed V. E. Churov and N. E. Konkin, 7 March 2012, No. 112/893-6.
